== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? (PC Errata)]]. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member article. Columns are Original and PC Errata only. Appendix A adds the [[Grabber]] icon; game text is otherwise the printed sentence. No Revised, Japanese, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the published change. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
